case: INVENTED — a Tier-3 page with no cache entry and no LLM available: the page is skipped, queued to state/pending-extraction.json, and the run still succeeds
note: ADR-0031, the invariant the whole harvest hangs off: the run never fails because the model is unavailable. The page is deliberately unclassifiable by pattern — no news slug, no citation-table markers, no DOI — so classify_page() returns None and the page escalates to Tier 3. With no cache entry and no credential, extract() returns None without even attempting a call, the URL is queued once, no cache entry is written, and nothing raises. This is not a hypothetical: GitHub Models has been answering 410 since 2026-09-01 (ADR-0030 status note), so the live harvest takes exactly this path.
expected_pending_reason: no cache entry and no model available
